findings.finding: Complete aggregate could be accepted before terminal cleanup and postflight.
findings.disposition: Require successful full-stage outcome and result, configuration and demonstration pins, zero side effects; negative controls cover missing outcome, cleanup/postflight failure and changed aggregate.

findings.finding: Git inspection failure could render clean and protected-file match was unconditional.
findings.disposition: Render inspection errors explicitly; committed and live protected-file claims depend on saved exit codes.

findings.finding: Bounds statement was unconditional and only covered interrupted cohort; continuation also lacked a size barrier.
findings.disposition: Conditional historical and fresh reporting; main-cohort builders now save an authority measurement before continuation and hold on excess or failed readback. Saved old packets reproduce all five prior totals. Focused stage/reporter cohort has 55 passes. Read-only re-review found no blocking defect.

findings.finding: Exact reproduction command names an already existing exclusive output.
findings.disposition: Label it as the recorded generating command and require a fresh output filename for rerun.

findings.finding: Every packet build overstates the main-cohort bounds barrier scope; private-control internal builders use a different path.
